---
title: LAI 1999-2020 (raster 1 km), global, 10-daily – version 2
---
### About
Defined as half the total area of green elements of the canopy per unit horizontal ground area. Every 10-days estimates are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of about 1 km covering the period from 1999 to June 2020 from SPOT/VEGETATION and PROBA-V data.

[View this dataset in Copernicus Browser](https://browser.dataspace.copernicus.eu/?zoom=9&lat=46.02622&lng=14.5253&themeId=DEFAULT-THEME&datasetId=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY&fromTime=2014-01-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z&toTime=2025-06-12T14:36:02.076470&layerId=FAPAR&demSource3D=%22MAPZEN%22&cloudCoverage=30&dateMode=SINGLE&clmsSelectedPath=Vegetation%20Properties&clmsSelectedCollection=COPERNICUS_CLMS_FAPAR_300M_10DAILY)
